name: What is the difference between framed and frameless cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between framed and frameless cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framed cabinets feature a solid wood face frame on the front of the cabinet box, providing stability and a traditional look. Doors attach to this frame. Frameless cabinets, also known as full access cabinets, do not have a face frame, offering a sleek, contemporary appearance and easier access to the interior. The choice often comes down to aesthetic preference and desired accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framed cabinets have a face frame for stability and traditional look, while frameless cabinets offer a sleek, contemporary look and easier access.
